deploy-bot: PROD deploy started — env=prod-usw2, tag=v3.6.4, commit=9b1a2fc, initiator=@Alice Chen, strategy=gradual-100, window=change-window-23:00-01:00 UTC :rocket:
Alice Chen: Kicking off cutover now. Watchlist: model-serving, kv-cache, metrics-dashboard. I’ll post smoke results in ~10m.
Ben Kumar: I'll watch infra and autoscaler. Alert channel set to #eng-oncall if CPU or OOM spikes.
Carol Diaz: Can we pin model variant to v3.6.4-quant for canaries? Previous canary used quantized and looked stable.
Dylan Park: Rollback checklist ready. If 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m or latency p50 regresses > 30% we revert to tag v3.6.3.
Alice Chen: @Carol good call — pinning canary to v3.6.4-quant now. deploy-bot: can you confirm fallback targets?
deploy-bot: Canary pinned to v3.6.4-quant. Fallback target set to tag=v3.6.3 (auto-failover enabled).
Erin Gomez: Heads-up: running post-deploy smoke: /health, /embed, /chat. Posting results when complete.
Ben Kumar: Observability: streaming CPU and RPS, setting temporary dashboard filters to prod-usw2/group=inference.
Alice Chen: Starting 10% traffic shift.
Ben Kumar: Metrics green so far — 10% for 2m, 200rps, no spike.
Alice Chen: Advancing to 50% traffic. Noted slight p95 increase on long-context LLMs but within SLO.
Dylan Park: Prepared rollback commands pinned in ops runbook: ```
# rollback to v3.6.3
deployctl promote --env prod-usw2 --tag v3.6.3 --strategy immediate
```
Erin Gomez: Smoke checks: /health OK, /embed latency 48ms, /chat token stream passes. All clear.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy complete — env=prod-usw2, tag=v3.6.4, commit=9b1a2fc, duration=65m, final_traffic=100%, status=success, artifacts=release-notes-3.6.4.md
Alice Chen: Nice. Filing release notes and assigning to @Carol for customer-facing summary.
Carol Diaz: Will draft release summary and changelog. Noting the quantized variant used for canary and fallback pin.
Ben Kumar: Will keep an eye on latency overnight, but looks clean. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Dylan Park: Closing rollback playbook unless we see anomalies overnight.
Erin Gomez: Running a short regression eval overnight; will ping if any quality regressions show up.
Alice Chen: Great job everyone. Closing thread.
